                            end
                        end)(Sr'',Sr'')}
                    end
                else
                    return yF(lj[1][1],1,lj[1][2])
                end
            until Jo==-1.4889098039215687*-31875
        end)())
    else
        return yF(XB[1][1],1,XB[1][2])
    end
end
